scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm --filter frontend build && pnpm --filter worker build
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter frontend lint && pnpm --filter worker lint
scripts.test: pnpm --filter frontend test && pnpm --filter worker test
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm --filter frontend typecheck && pnpm --filter worker typecheck && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
